facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_劫财 (Fire carrying The Rival). Persona The Rival (劫财). Definition line: "Same nature, different register, the edge of comparison". Keyword Rivalry, charge fierce, poles catalyst Daring / friction Drain. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: comparison as fuel; the race never announces a finish. Arena: the race, the shared prize, the other runner. Classical portrait: same nature, different register; comparison as fuel; the race with no announced finish. Ruled domains: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 比肩.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Fire. structural_interaction seed: "Warmth meeting warmth cross-polarity — presence competing with presence".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Rival: flame that leaps between torches. You catch ambition from the people around you and pass yours back doubled, the most contagious energy in any gathering. Stakes make you luminous. The same draft that spreads your fire can spread it thin, so choose which blazes are actually yours."
- k2_functional: "Your energy flares with company and stakes, then needs true dark to recover."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Spark-chasing","Fearless","Electrifying"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Rivalry":"Your rivals are accelerants: nothing focuses your flame like a nearby blaze. Keep rivalry ritual, races and games and friendly scoreboards, so the heat builds camaraderie instead of ash.","Shared stakes":"You fund and join easily, splitting bills and risks in the same warm gesture. Enthusiasm signs faster than judgment reads. Let every shared blaze get one cold morning review before you pour fuel.","Boldness":"Your boldness ignites others, which multiplies its consequences. Lead the charges worth leading. A spark that picks its tinder builds bonfires. One that does not builds regrets."}

- Sibling cell 火_比肩 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Self-lit","Vivid","Undimmed"],"friction":["Too proud","Touchy","Unapproachable"]}
- Sibling cell 火_比肩 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your flame refuses to be seen flickering. The struggle stays private, the help gets declined at the door, the apology exits in a dialect nobody recognizes as one. Being impressive is mandatory, being witnessed mid-failure is not survivable, and the policy costs you exactly what it protects."

Core element Fire, energy element Fire. Law: Fire and Fire are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Fire is this core's Body. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core that shows Fire on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Fire as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 火_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You hate to lose more than you love to win, and the gap shows. You read a rival's win as your loss, since the Fire in you outlasts a single victory. You turn every friendly game into a fight and miss the fun of playing.

value_b.text: Losing is the single thing you take personally, even in a game. Being second feels like being nothing, and you would rather fall out over a point than let it go. Remember that you can lose a point far more easily than a friend.

value.text: Hating to lose keeps you in every contest long after it stops paying. You would sooner stay in a losing race than be the first to step off, so you stay. For every race you refuse to leave, you give up a night of sleep.

value.text: You spend for show whenever the table is watching. Picking up the bill feels like winning the night, so you pay for everyone rather than let a rival pay for you. You were buying a place at the table that was already yours.

value_b.text: Spending for show is how you look like the bigger person. You would sooner spend where the audience is than save where nobody looks, since being seen giving is half the pleasure. Remember that you are paying for applause that was already yours.

value.text: You are never off, because off feels like falling behind. You would rather run past everyone than stop and ask who was racing you, since you see no finish. As the only one timing this race, you are free to call it done.

value_b.text: Switching off is the single skill you never learned. Stopping feels like being passed, so you keep going instead of letting a rival catch you resting. You are racing people who went home long ago, remember.

value.text: Never being off is your pride and what wears you down. You keep the pace up rather than admit you are tired, because tired looks like losing. Later you repay every skipped rest, and at a higher price.

value.text: Even beside a friend you never switch off, handing them a race instead of yourself. Being ahead counts more with you than being beside someone, so you turn a walk into a pace. You keep from them a friend with nothing to prove.
